title: Signature Rapid-Scene Framework
description: Manon's original rapid-scene framework compresses the first five minutes of any emergency into a single repeatable loop: Scan, Anchor, Communicate, Act, Re-scan. Scan reads hazards in a 360 sweep; Anchor fixes one safe reference point the whole crew orients to; Communicate pushes one plain-language update before anyone touches a tool; Act executes the smallest useful intervention first; Re-scan checks whether the scene changed under you. It is designed to sit on top of ICS and START without replacing either.

title: Signature Buddy-Pair Accountability
description: Manon's buddy-pair accountability protocol makes the two-person team the atomic unit of personnel tracking: nobody enters, moves, or exits a hazard zone without their pair, and the pair checks in as one call sign. If a pair separates, both members stop work and re-link before anything else — the protocol treats a broken pair as a mayday-in-waiting. It layers onto existing PAR checks without adding radio traffic.

title: Signature Plain-Speech Card
description: Manon's plain-speech card is a pocket reference that converts the twenty most-used ten-codes into the NIMS plain-language equivalents, with a fill-in-the-blank mayday script on the back. It is meant to be memorized, then carried anyway.

title: Signature Citizen-Responder Bridge
description: Manon's citizen-responder bridge is a procedure for the minutes before professionals arrive: dispatchers coach callers through a three-task script — secure the scene (hazards off, doors unlocked), start the one intervention (compressions, bleeding control), and station someone to flag down responders. It treats the caller as the true first responder and gives them exactly three jobs, because three is what a panicking person can hold. The script is designed to be read verbatim by any dispatcher.
